scope: Independent review of the delivered exact-fit-gated portable replay stage

logic_errors.finding: Established frozen scientific reader digests can be overwritten by current hashes after protocol sealing.
logic_errors.reproduction: A software probe appended a comment to METRIC_HELPER immediately after protocol sealing. Replay returned verified with conflicting helper hashes in the release protocol and final replay receipt.
logic_errors.required_fix: Preserve established hashes, reject conflicting binding merges, and validate original release/preparation bindings before loading helpers.

logic_errors.finding: Stored verification accepts contradictory result/provenance metadata or a missing evidence set when receipt hashes are recomputed.
logic_errors.reproduction: Software fixtures accepted selected_epoch=0, parameters=1, policy={}, qualified/installed=true and wrong prediction/selection hashes after updating receipt bindings. Changed listening/completeness/output flags also passed. Deleting comparison.json, staged selection, data-freeze, protocol and evaluator log with corresponding bindings still passed.
logic_errors.required_fix: Require a fixed nonempty artifact set and reapply the fresh replay's full result/provenance contracts.

logic_errors.finding: Audio containment checks are skipped when reusing an existing preparation receipt.
logic_errors.reproduction: Replacing run/audio with an escaping directory symlink after preparation still allowed verified replay with synthetic WAVs, the unchanged WAV/PCM reader and software runtime. WAV/PCM identity checks worked but run containment did not.
logic_errors.required_fix: Repeat no-PCM directory and per-file audio containment/link checks on reuse before evaluation.

suggestions: Focused negative fixtures suffice; no environment framework or numerical retuning is needed.
